title: Gerri Berendzen to give Budig Writing Lecture on the value of revision in the age of AI
summary_en: Gerri Berendzen, lecturer in the William Allen White School of Journalism & Mass Communications and coordinator of the Bremner Editing Center, will present “When Writing and Editing Meet: The Growing Value of Revision” at 2 p.m. Nov. 2.
title_cn: Gerri Berendzen to give Budig Writing Lecture on the value of revision in the age of AI

title: Dean Carol Smith elected to Association of Research Libraries board of directors
summary_en: KU Libraries Dean Carol Smith was elected to the 2027 board of directors of the Association of Research Libraries during the association’s fall meeting in Alexandria, Virginia. She will begin her three-year term Jan. 1, 2027.
title_cn: Dean Carol Smith elected to Association of Research Libraries board of directors
